issues.description: recursive_trace duplicates reached children instead of including the starting node, while the admitted trace length theorem is false even for an empty path.
issues.rationale: For root r and one-edge child c, recursive_trace returns [c,c], not the documented [r,c]; a missing child returns [] rather than the visited prefix. Independently, trace_no_longer_than_path([]) claims len([r]) <= 0. Repair ab845472 prepends self.value, preserves it on a missing child, changes the bound to path.len()+1, and proves the corrected lemmas; 9d8e1b1 updates FVT11's root-inclusive cursor invariant.

issues.description: seek_trace_next exports an admitted child/trace equality without requiring a resolvable path, present child, valid depth, or in-range child index.
issues.rationale: The theorem unwraps seek(path), indexes children[idx], unwraps that child, and indexes trace[path.len()+1], yet has no requires clause. A missing path, absent child, or idx >= N lacks the required domains. Repair ab845472 adds tree/path/depth/index and Some preconditions and proves the equality; 9d8e1b1 supplies those facts at FVT11 callers.

issues.description: The admitted removal lemmas claim a removed child is absent from the entire subtree even though the tree invariant permits the same child value at another key or path.
issues.rationale: Node::inv does not require child nodes/values to be unique. A parent can store equal child node values at k1 and k2; removing k1 leaves the same node reachable at k2, contradicting lemma_remove_not_on_subtree. An alternate path analogously contradicts the recursive theorem. Repair ab845472 removes both false callable theorem APIs and their broadcast entries.
